Accounts needs all October supplier invoices by Friday to close the VAT return.

top_items.one_line: Claims the school event is cancelled, but the sender domain looks like an impersonation; verify via a known contact before acting.
School pickup of 12 serviced bikes was due today; confirm the event status directly with the school given the suspicious cancellation email.
Atlantic Tyres requests new bank details; independently verify using the supplier’s known contact before changing payment records.
Overdue Gaia Lights invoice may put the account on hold Wednesday and delay a pending shipment; accounts should review promptly.
Customer alleges a duplicate €214.60 charge and threatens a formal complaint if not refunded by 12 November.
Mailbox-closure email links to a lookalike domain; treat as phishing and do not click.
Sales reports low stock of 700×28 inner tubes and requests an order for 50.
Accounts needs October supplier invoices by Friday to close the VAT return.

Follow-up on RC-1002 adds a delivery-address change request; confirm it with the customer before updating.
